name: com.xipfax/fax
title: XipFax
description: Fax any document to any fax number from your AI assistant, and check the fax before it goes.

tools.name: find_fax_number
tools.description: Use this when the person is faxing an IRS office and doesn’t have its fax number. Finds the fax number of the IRS office that takes a form or a notice, from XipFax’s list of offices, read from the IRS’s own pages. Give the form or the notice by its name or number alone, such as Form 2848, SS-4 or CP2000. Where the IRS gives a number for each state, give the place too. The list holds IRS offices alone: for anyone else, ask the person for the fax number, which send_fax and send_fax_link take.

form.description: The form or notice by its name or number alone: Form 2848, SS-4, CP2000.

place.description: Where the person lives, or where the business is, by its postal code, such as OH for Ohio or PR for Puerto Rico; APO-FPO for an APO or FPO address; ABROAD for anywhere outside the United States.

tools.name: quote_fax
tools.description: Use this when the person asks what a fax costs, or before a fax they’ll pay for is sent. The price of sending one fax of a number of pages with XipFax to a fax number, without a plan, from XipFax’s price list, which prices a fax by the number it goes to. With no number, the price to a number in the United States, its territories or Canada. plan_covers says whether the plan covers a fax to the number, for a person who has one.

pages.description: The pages to send, from 1 to 250.

fax_number.description: A fax number, with its country code: +44 20 7946 0958. One in the United States, its territories or Canada needs none: 202 555 0143.

tools.name: send_fax_link
tools.description: Use this when the person would rather add their pages and send the fax on XipFax’s own send screen than sign in to XipFax here. A link that opens XipFax’s send screen with the fax number filled in: an office by its office_id from find_fax_number, or a fax number. The person adds their pages there, signs in and pays.

office_id.description: The office, as find_fax_number gives it.

fax_number.description: A fax number, with its country code: +44 20 7946 0958. One in the United States, its territories or Canada needs none: 202 555 0143.

tools.name: send_fax
tools.description: Use this when the person’s pages are on their draft and they want the fax sent. Sends the person’s XipFax draft to a fax number, or to an office by its office_id from find_fax_number. Give document_ids, as finish_fax_file gave them, in the order you added them. It goes at once only where the person has a plan, quote_fax’s plan_covers is true for the number, and they chose Send straight away for you, when they connected you or since. Otherwise nothing is sent: the answer is a link where they look the fax over, send it and pay where they have no plan or their plan doesn’t cover the number, so give them the link and never say it went. A draft with no pages, or with other pages than those you name or in another order, also answers a link, where they add or check them.

office_id.description: The office, as find_fax_number gives it.

fax_number.description: A fax number, with its country code: +44 20 7946 0958. One in the United States, its territories or Canada needs none: 202 555 0143.

document_ids.description: The draft’s documents, as finish_fax_file gave them, in the order you added them.

tools.name: get_fax
tools.description: Use this when the person asks how a fax went, or about a fax they received. How a fax of the person’s went, by its id, as send_fax gave it: whether it is sending and how far it has got, delivered, or failed and why, and when it is tried again, with its pages, its price and its times. Answers a fax they received too. For a delivered fax’s confirmation, use get_fax_confirmation.

fax_id.description: The fax, by its id, as send_fax gave it.

tools.name: get_fax_confirmation
tools.description: Use this when the person needs proof that a fax they sent was delivered, to keep or to pass on. The confirmation of a fax the person sent that was delivered: one page that says who received how many pages, from whom and when, which they can pass on. Answers a link that reads it, as a PDF, for a few minutes: give the person the link. Refused, saying why, for a fax not delivered.

fax_id.description: The fax, by its id, as send_fax gave it.

tools.name: add_fax_file
tools.description: Use this when the person’s file is on their own disk, where you can run commands. Puts a PDF from the person’s own disk on their XipFax draft. A photo of any kind, such as a JPEG, PNG, HEIC, WebP, GIF or AVIF, goes as a PDF made from it first on their computer, upright as a photo viewer shows it: on a Mac, `sips -Z 2100 -s format pdf <photo> --out <name>.pdf` makes one, upright and at most 2,100 pixels on its long side. Any other kind of file, such as a Word file, goes once saved as a PDF. Work out the PDF’s size in bytes and its SHA-256 first, with a command such as `shasum -a 256 <file>`, and give both. The answer is an address good for 15 minutes and the headers to send with the file: PUT the file’s exact bytes there with each of those headers, such as with `curl --upload-file <file> -H "<name>: <value>" "<address>"`, then call finish_fax_file. The address takes this file alone. PDFs only, 40 MB at most.

name.description: Its name, such as its file’s: 255 characters at most.

size_bytes.description: Its size in bytes: a PDF of 40 MB at most.

sha256.description: Its SHA-256 in hex, 64 characters, as `shasum -a 256 <file>` prints it.

tools.name: finish_fax_file
tools.description: Use this once the file’s PUT to the address add_fax_file gave has answered 200. Asks XipFax to read the file back and count its pages. Answers the document, ready to send, with its pages; refused where the file never arrived, is locked or unreadable, or takes the fax past the pages a fax may hold. Give send_fax its id.

document_id.description: The document, as add_fax_file gave it.

tools.name: add_fax_file_from_url
tools.description: Use this when the person’s PDF or photo is at a public link. Puts a PDF, or a JPEG or a PNG photo, at a public address on the person’s XipFax draft: XipFax fetches it from the link, which must answer with the file itself, reads a PDF’s pages and makes a photo into one Letter page. Answers the document, ready to send, with its pages; refused, saying why, where XipFax can’t fetch it, or the file is locked, unreadable, too large or takes the fax past the pages a fax may hold, and then nothing is added. For a file on the person’s own disk, use add_fax_file. Give send_fax its id.

name.description: Its name, such as its file’s: 255 characters at most.

url.description: Where XipFax fetches it from: an https link to a public address that answers with the file itself, 40 MB at most, within 15 seconds. The file is a PDF, or a JPEG or a PNG photo, which XipFax makes into a Letter page. XipFax follows no redirect.

tools.name: add_fax_file_link
tools.description: Use this when you can’t reach the person’s file or pass it to add_fax_file, such as one on their phone or one attached to this chat. Gives an address where the person adds their pages to their XipFax draft from their own browser, PDFs or photos, with no sign-in there. Give the address to the person alone, since whoever holds it can add pages to their draft. It works once, for 30 minutes. Ask them to add their pages there, press “Done adding pages”, and tell you when they’re done; then call finish_fax_file_link with its link_id.

tools.name: finish_fax_file_link
tools.description: Use this once the person says they’re done adding their pages at the address add_fax_file_link gave. Answers the documents it put on their draft, ready to send, with their pages. Until they’ve pressed “Done adding pages” there, added is false, there are no documents, and ask says what to ask of them: to add their pages there, press “Done adding pages”, and tell you when they’re done; then call again. Give send_fax their ids, with any others you added, in the order you added them.

link_id.description: The link, as add_fax_file_link gave it.
